about: How a chat message that ran a skill reads outside the model's turn (docs/dev/skills.md 'Titles and exports'): gamma/skills.py display and title, frontend/src/chat/skills.js skillText and skillTitle. display is the whole message as Copy message, the export and an agent's earlier messages show it: '/name', then a space and the text, or a blank line and the text when it opens with a quoted passage; the text alone without a skill. title is a conversation's name when the user never gave one: the first non-blank line that is not a quote, after '/name' when the message ran a skill, its blanks folded to one space and cut to 80 characters.
